snippet.title: Cereal Killer (Trailer)
snippet.description:
GAME LINK: https://caramelgames.itch.io/cereal-killer

Follow Milton, a farmer who witnesses strange events on his farm until he realizes that his cereal plantation is more alive than it should be..

Note: This game is part of the Crimson Trails series, where we take Brazilian folklore and culture, toss them into a blender with horror and comedy, and create a fictional universe! The themes, acts, and characters in this game are our own inventions for this fictional universe; we do not aim to represent religions (whether Abrahamic, Afro, Indigenous, or any other tradition), political groups, criminal factions, militias, police officers, annoying activists from X, idiotic patriots, pets, real people, or anything you might find outside our rotten brains. Any resemblance to reality is purely coincidental (either you’re seeing things or you didn’t quite get it!). We have no intention of offending beliefs, cultures, thieving neighbors stealing lunchboxes, mutant corns, wandering heads, beautiful women, or anyone else.

All the stories in our games take place in the same universe and will be interconnected in the future, but the games make sense when played individually.
